kind: Selected vector paths extracted from already fitted, published figure panels; not native model spectra
changes_from_original: Selected monotone vector traces only; preserve original graphic coordinates and segments. Linear tick calibration converts coordinates to plotted wavelength and relative Fnu. Labels OCR-checked; no authors model refitting or flux-vector precision claimed.
source_figure_semantics: Red curves are published best-fitting DZ/DQ models; black curves are authors plotted DESI observations smoothed over 5 samples (0.8 Angstrom per sample). These are the data used in the published fits, not held-out or independent observations.

selection_evidence.mapping: Filter table1 rows in order: DQ substring in spectral type -> 701 DQ PDF pages; otherwise Z substring -> 1002 DZ PDF pages. Page labels independently confirm all 25 exact Gaia IDs after removal of OCR-inserted whitespace only.

uncertainty_limit: Plotted line coordinates have about 0.24 PDF-point quantization; spectra shown smoothed; native uncertainties, resolution kernels and masks are not present in these paths. Residuals support wavelength targeting only, not chi-squared, abundance estimates or significance.
